title: Junta restriction sample program

hypotheses_covered: $P$ is a finite set of coordinates in $[n]$
$z$ assigns a sign to each coordinate in $P$
the failure parameter is rational and satisfies $0<\delta\leq 1/2$
caveat: The exact batch size and work charge depend on named functions whose definitions are not included in the payload.
